ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with ACE 436. Provides participants an in-depth, experiential immersion into the complex issues and constraints that confront international marketing channel participants. Contextually grounded and themed in a specific industry, the course combines on-campus lectures with an intensive international immersion experience to Europe, Asia, or Latin America. By following the complete marketing channel from raw materials procurement to final consumption, participants gain first-hand knowledge of the necessary managerial decision-making skills required to successfully operate in today's global business environment. Course includes travel to Croatia in late May. Students must apply at studyabroad.illinois.edu and be selected to enroll. Email Lauren Karplus (lkarpl2@illinois.edu) for instructor approval.
